text:
Aisha: quick sync 1min1: we need a single mental model for pagination + retry across py/ts/go. want minimal surprises for app devs.
Jon: tl;dr: default safe defaults + explicit opt-ins for aggressive optimizations (prefetch, auto-resume).
Ravi: concrete constraints: hosted API should favor low-latency (fewer retries), Dedicated/private can be more conservative with retries, but SDK should not encode infra policy. it should let callers opt into a policy that matches infra.
Lena: proposal sketch:
- RetryPolicy object (per-client, override per-call)
  - fields: retryable_codes (list), max_attempts, backoff_ms_base, multiplier, max_backoff_ms, jitter_frac
- Pagination helpers: `.pages()` (yields pages) and `.items()` (yields flattened items). default: `.items()` to be ergonomic.
- Prefetch: opt-in via `items(prefetch_pages=N)` default 0. not enabled by default.
Aisha: agree on shape. edgecases?
Jon: resume tokens: always opaque strings from server. SDK must never try to reconstruct offsets. resume token available on page boundary: pages() returns (items, resume_token). items() should stash latest resume_token and expose it via `iterator.resume_token` property.
Ravi: streaming: treat as separate contract. streaming = ordered chunks; do not retry mid-stream unless server provides resume_token and caller explicitly passes it back to the constructor for resumed session.
Lena: language ergonomics:
- python: iterator object with `.pages()` generator and `.items()` generator. `.items(prefetch_pages=N)` param. expose `iterator.resume_token` attribute.
- ts: same `pages()` / `items()` methods returning AsyncIterable. expose `iterator.getResumeToken()` (explicit getter preferred over property).
- go: return `Pager` with `Next(ctx) ([]Item, error)` and `ResumeToken() string`. for items-level convenience we provide `ItemIterator` which yields one item at a time, backed by the pager.
Jon: retry semantics w.r.t pagination: if a page fetch fails after partial processing, it's unsafe to re-fetch the same page and re-deliver items (duplicates). Options: a) make items idempotent at app layer (not ideal), b) only retry whole-page fetches before delivering any items to caller, c) surface a dedupe helper.
Aisha: b) plus doc guidance. SDK implementer: fetch page, buffer items, then yield to user. if page fetch fails, retry according to RetryPolicy. once items are yielded, no auto retry for that page. duplicates are caller's responsibility if they consume and commit externally.
Ravi: good. add a `at_least_once` vs `at_most_once` wording in docs. default behavior will be `at_least_once` at call-level (i.e., items may be repeated on retries) but with our buffered-yield approach it's actually `at_most_once` per successful page fetch; clarify in docs.
Lena: telemetry: emit events: page_fetch_attempts, page_fetch_retries, total_pages_fetched, items_returned, resume_token_used. Console can surface per-call costs.
Jon: default retryable codes: 429, 503. 500 is NOT retryable by default. expose map in RetryPolicy.default().
Aisha: sample python snippet to align teams:
```python
client = RedwoodClient(retry_policy=RetryPolicy.default())
pager = client.list_records(project)
for item in pager.items(prefetch_pages=1):
    process(item)
# access resume token if needed
print(pager.resume_token)
```
Ravi: TS example:
```ts
const client = new RedwoodClient({ retryPolicy: RetryPolicy.default() })
const iter = client.listRecords(project)
for await (const item of iter.items({ prefetch_pages: 0 })) {
  await process(item)
}
console.log(iter.getResumeToken())
```
Lena: go example (sketch):
```go
pager := client.ListRecords(ctx, project)
for {
  items, err := pager.Next(ctx)
  if err == iterator.Done { break }
  if err != nil { return err }
  for _, it := range items { process(it) }
}
fmt.Println(pager.ResumeToken())
```
build-bot: Draft RFC created: https://redwood.internal/rfc/1482 (WIP)
Aisha: next steps: - Sam (eng-platform) and Lena (sdk) to co-author RFC with tests (simulate 429 + mid-page failure), - SDK teams add iterator helpers + ensure transports expose capability flags: supports_stream_resume, supports_resume_tokens, supports_http2_streams.
Jon: we should also add a small dogfooding app that uses `prefetch_pages=2` and watch Console for extra requests.
Ravi: one more note: for private infra where golden data ordering matters, recommend customers set `max_attempts=1` and handle retries at infra layer. document this pattern.
Aisha: perfect. I'll collect these and push an RFC PR. meeting adjourned. :raised_hands:
